suites.title: Diagnostic: V2-2 schema closure (schema_closure_vectors.json)
suites.claim: At the corpus verification_time under its verifier_policy, the base and the permitted extensions (bundle.x_ext, unsigned in an open object; audit_entries[0].evidence.x_ext, open and re-signed with every commitment redone) verify, and every case that adds a member to a closed object of the V2 schemas, or a value outside an enumeration, is rejected (verified false), even when every signature and hash is independently valid. A verifier that accepts such a case fails it: a recorded gap, never conformance.
limits: Diagnostic and opt-in: its failures stay failures. It does not change the default catalog (/1, 38 cases), the evidence catalog (/2, 241 cases) or the admission catalog (/3, 140 cases).

The wrappers call each SDK's fixed-time verification API. The reference verifyV2SignedBundle (lib/verify.js) has no injectable clock and is not run here; validateV2Bundle composed with a verifier is a composition, reported apart by tools/conformance/schema-boundary.js, not an API enforcing V2-2.

One member per case: a sample of the closure rules (root, signature, signer, composite_sig, SignedPayload envelope, binding enumeration, manifest, intent payload, audit entry, key entry), not every closed object of the schemas.
Every negative counts only if the base passed in the same run; the stale evidence case also needs its re-signed twin to pass. Rejection messages are not judged (no error_contains).
Built only from tests/interop/v2/schema_closure_vectors.json, signed with the committed TEST-ONLY keys of interop_vectors.json#test_keys; nothing is generated or signed by the runner.
